messages.subject: S1 review: FAIL
messages.body: Reviewed S1 (head 50560a1f1db5e41d1d73b9eccb77b1db44b1f9f1) read-only against AC-2/AC-3: verdict FAIL although all 20 tests pass. Three Required defects were found by probing and none is guarded by a test: a duplicate-suffix collision (A, A, A-1, A gives a-1 twice, toc.py:53), slugs built from raw markdown instead of rendered text (toc.py:43), and a fence opened on a list-item line leaking headings (toc.py:7); the --stdout wiring did not regress F0. Left for the builder: fix the three and add a test for each; Optional/Nit items (combining marks, empty headings, --max-depth 0) can wait.
